stock.description: RENHENG Enterprise Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture and sale of tobacco machinery products in the People’s Republic of China. The company offers casing and flavoring systems, pneumatic feeding systems, and pre-pressing packing machines, dedusting system, and swelling agent delivery system. It also provides maintenance, overhaul and modification services. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Admiralty, Hong Kong.
